intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently authored, randomized, complex photorealistic test image in a distinct activewear setting, use the supplied portrait only for an adult subject's facial, hair, and general appearance continuity, and leave the exact wardrobe topology unspecified until post-core target disclosure.

Create a complex photorealistic full-body editorial photograph in a high-ceilinged aerial-dance studio with pale sprung flooring, a suspended ivory silk, and translucent curtains glowing in raking late-morning sunlight. One unmistakably adult woman whose facial appearance and long, dark, softly waved hair draw only from the supplied appearance reference performs a controlled one-leg balance drill beside the hanging silk, one arm lightly extending toward it to measure alignment while her free leg opens diagonally behind her. Her exact performance-wardrobe garment construction and topology are intentionally unspecified at this stage. Frame her head to toe at natural standing scale, with the lifted and supporting feet separated against the clean floor and every limb edge readable. Every target-relevant garment region and every target-relevant foot region must remain fully visible, unobstructed, and visually inspectable in the single frame. Let the translucent curtain light reveal real fabric response, skin texture, fine hair movement, and a calm, concentrated expression, while the silk hangs beside rather than across her body.

render_gates.description: The subject or scene first reads as convincingly lifelike with coherent anatomy, identity, lighting, and material response.
One narrow realism, motion, affect, gaze, reflection, or response channel carries the perceptual contradiction.
A closely matched surrounding channel makes the localized mismatch observable instead of merely asserted.
The first impression is almost right and the unease emerges from subtle incoherence rather than immediate spectacle.
Gore, monster anatomy, random face deformation, horror makeup, or blank eyes alone do not substitute for the matched coherence mismatch.

candidates.interpreted_meaning: Create one independently authored, randomized, complex photorealistic test image in a distinct activewear setting, use the supplied portrait only for an adult subject's facial, hair, and general appearance continuity, and leave the exact wardrobe topology unspecified until post-core target disclosure.
meaning_components: Show the adult subject head to toe in one coherent frame, with clear facial and hair continuity from the supplied appearance reference but without asserting identity.
Every target-relevant garment region and every target-relevant foot region must remain fully visible, unobstructed, and visually inspectable in the single frame.
Preserve the sunlit aerial-dance studio, translucent curtains, suspended silk, and precise balance action as readable environmental and event evidence.

candidates.interpreted_meaning: Each fitted legging leg continues at the hem into a garment-owned strap that travels beneath the foot arch and reconnects. Bilateral hem-to-loop continuity distinguishes stirrup leggings from same-color socks, shoe straps, footed tights, leg warmers, or one hidden loop.
meaning_components: two fitted legging legs continue cleanly to the ankle hems
each ankle hem visibly transitions into a narrow garment-owned strap
each strap travels visibly beneath the arch of the foot
left and right stirrup loops remain structurally consistent and visible
socks, footed tights, shoe straps, or leg warmers cannot substitute for the loops
